title: Fitzsimons
html_source: Robert James “Bob” Fitzsimmons (1863 – 1917) was a British born professional boxer who made boxing history as the sport’s first three-division world champion. He also achieved fame for beating Gentleman Jim Corbett, the man who beat John L. Sullivan and is in The Guinness Book of World Records as the lightest Heavyweight Champion. Considered one of the hardest punchers in boxing history, Fitzsimmons is ranked as No. 8 on Ring Magazine’s list of 100 greatest punchers of all time.
